params.body:
`bin/queue-cited-sources.mjs --apply` run a second time added every citation to the "cited N times" count of the queued publishers again, so on the box the counts on the Sources page are now doubled. The doc said a second run adds nothing; for new rows that held, for the counts it did not.

A citation is now a key: the post and the page (`urlKey`). The listing keeps the keys in `cites`, and `cited` is their number. Citing the same page in the same post again, or filling the queue again, changes nothing. A row queued before this change has only the running count; the next fill rebuilds it from the keys.

On the box after merge and deploy: `node bin/queue-cited-sources.mjs --apply` once. That puts the counts right; it adds no publishers.

Tests: `test/cited-sources.test.mjs` covers a refill that counts nothing twice and a row with an old count that is rebuilt. Full suite 1308/1314; the 6 failures are `report-render`, which needs `pdftoppm` (not installed on the workbench). Typecheck clean.

Refs #364
